issues.issue: The Debt Service Fund column's 14,045.00 on the Wastewater line is a bond payment (outstanding bond on p4). The page prints it separately by column, so it could be split out as debt service. As recorded, it is counted as utilities spending.
This is 49% of receipts and sits in 'other'. The printed label says Other, and nothing in the trim explains it (probably utility charges). It is already flagged for review.

The equity item is the printed subtotal line, which also appears as total_equity. The amount is right, but a subtotal is being used as a line item. Also, total_assets is marked computed even though line 28 prints it.
